title: dev.qory.runtime.result
description: The result of a non-interactive launch: the result a session printed on its standard output, with outcome, turns, cost and tokens, or for Codex, which prints none, the result the session writes at the end of each launch, with outcome and tokens.

session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the record, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started.

line.description: The number of the line of the session's standard output the record was read from, from 1, counting every line, whether it is a JSON object or not. The session sets it on an event of the output source; an event of a hook has none, and a result the session writes for Codex has none.

outcome.description: success, or the runtime's error kind: error_max_turns, error_during_execution. A launch of Codex has success when its session ended succeeded, and error_during_execution otherwise.

is_error.description: Whether the launch ended in an error. A paused launch of Codex, after model_key_limit or model_key_switch, has error_during_execution with is_error false.

result.description: The final response text, when the runtime printed one.

usage.description: The tokens of the runtime's launch so far, subagents included: Claude Code's modelUsage, summed over the models; for Codex, each rollout's last total less its total before the launch, for the rollout of the launch's thread and those of its child agents. A launch can write several result lines, and each has the launch's total up to it. The four counts do not overlap; their sum is the launch's total. Absent when the record has no token counts: unknown, never 0.

input.description: Input tokens neither read from nor written to the cache.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the cache.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the cache, of every cache lifetime.
